key_points: People Inc. cancelled its $9.3 bn offer for a 73.9% stake in MGM, triggering a 9% after‑hours slump
Market speculation that MGM may now pursue a bid for People adds uncertainty but no concrete terms yet
No earnings, guidance, or regulatory news – the move is purely M&A‑related volatility
If a deal materialises it could reshape MGM’s balance sheet, but the likelihood remains unclear
Short‑term price pressure is notable; long‑term investment thesis unchanged
